title: fix(cam): contain /api/headstock/transition/gcode before generation (HEADSTOCK-TRANSITION-GCODE-SAFETY-001 PR A)
intent: Fail-closed containment of a live, unauthenticated, ungoverned G-code emitter whose default program commands 21 X+Z rapids ending below Z0 and a minimum Z of -46.76 mm on a 21 mm neck. Containment, not qualification; repair needs separate rulings.
behavior_change: POST /api/headstock/transition/gcode returns HTTP 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED (ok=false, reason HEADSTOCK_TRANSITION_NOT_MANUFACTURING_QUALIFIED, order_id HEADSTOCK-TRANSITION-GCODE-SAFETY-001) for every valid request, with no program, no program hash and no attachment. /dxf, /analysis, the generator and the browser twin are unchanged. /dxf's pre-existing 500 (HST-06) is recorded, not repaired.

diff_articulation.what_changed: A readiness call before generation in one route handler, one BLOCKED readiness record, a canonically regenerated inventory and report, a containment test module, one-key additions to two registry key-set pins, and live-ungoverned 13 -> 12 in three inventory-delta pins.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The route had no readiness gate, authentication, safety decorator or tests, and the inventory listed it LIVE_UNGOVERNED. No existing containment covers /api/headstock/transition/*.
